name: Axe

counters.reason: Berserker's Call pierces Blade Fury and locks him during Omnislash
Call plus Counter Helix shreds her low base health
Blink Call jumps his backline before the team peels

counterItems.when: Reflect burst when Called targets focus you
Call initiations before enemies scatter

skillTips: Save Call for the enemy carry's big spell or escape
Spin with Counter Helix by drawing auto-attacks in lane

name: Lion

counters.reason: Hex and Earth Spike pierce Blade Fury spin
Instant Hex cancels Black Hole channel
Double disables plus Finger burst delete her before crits land

counterItems.when: Hex the Black Hole or Omnislash from fog
Reposition allies out of Call and Ravage

skillTips: Hold Hex for the channel or escape, never open with it
Stack Earth Spike after Hex for the full disable chain

name: Juggernaut

counters.reason: Spin plus Omnislash run down her slow, squishy support
Blade Fury closes the range gap and Healing Ward out-sustains Shrapnel
Magic-immune spin ignores Gust silence and runs her down

counterItems.when: Ignore Lion Hex and Ravage during Omnislash
Dispel slows and split-push against Tidehunter lineups

skillTips: Spin offensively to dodge Call timing, not just to escape
Ward before Omnislash so the target cannot hide in fog

name: Phantom Assassin

counters.reason: Phantom Strike jumps his range advantage and crits burst him
Gap close plus Blur dodge beats her stand-and-shoot
Jump, silence the Frostbite, delete the support first

counterItems.when: Stop Lion Hex and Earthshaker Echo mid-jump
Out-lifesteal Axe Call focus and Tidehunter Anchor Smash

skillTips: Enter after Call and Ravage are spent, never first
Blur up before jumping Sniper so the first shots miss

name: Crystal Maiden

counters.reason: Frostbite roots the melee carry so the team kites him
Instant Frostbite cancels Black Hole from safety

counterItems.when: Hide allies from Pudge hooks and PA jumps
Break Sven Storm Hammer range and push allies out

skillTips: Hold Frostbite for Black Hole and Storm Hammer, not lane harass
Freezing Field only after enemy jumps are down

name: Sven

counters.reason: Storm Hammer plus God's Strength bursts her before Gust matters
Stun and cleave delete the squishy support in one combo
Blink stun closes range and cleave ignores Take Aim distance

counterItems.when: God's Strength through Lion and Tidehunter disables
Storm Hammer the backline before Glimmer saves them

skillTips: Pop God's Strength after the enemy support shows, not before
Warcry before jumping so slows do not strand you

name: Drow Ranger

counters.reason: Long-range silence cancels Black Hole before it starts
Gust plus range kites the melee initiator off Ravage angles
Range and silence bully the slow support out of lane

counterItems.when: Dispel Lion Hex setup and dodge Pudge hooks with illusions
Stand through Ravage and Echo to keep shooting

skillTips: Save Gust for the Black Hole and Blink initiations
Never stand still against Axe: keep Call range in mind

name: Pudge

counters.reason: Hook drags the immobile shooter into Rot and Dismember
Hook through fog punishes her slow, ward-dependent positioning
Hook breaks her range comfort and Rot slows the escape

counterItems.when: Blink Dismember the Lion before Hex lands
Punish Phantom Assassin and Sven for focusing you

skillTips: Hook the Sniper the moment Take Aim channels, not earlier
Rot toggle discipline: never die to your own Rot under Ravage

name: Earthshaker

counters.reason: Echo Slam scales on her grouped team and deletes her
Fissure kites God's Strength duration out, Echo punishes cleave clumps
Blink Echo reaches the backline she hides in

counterItems.when: Core item: Echo without Blink almost never lands
Second Echo wave against Tidehunter and Enigma clusters

skillTips: Hold Echo for the clump, never solo-Echo the Axe
Fissure the Sven charge path, not the Sven himself

name: Sniper

counters.reason: Extreme range harasses the jungler and Shrapnel spots Midnight setups
Keeps distance on the melee initiator and headshots the Blink approach
Range advantage keeps the short-range disabler out of Hex range

counterItems.when: Push away Axe Call and Pudge Rot follow-ups
Assassinate through Lion and Tidehunter combo chains

skillTips: Position behind the Tidehunter, never beside him
Assassinate the Enigma first if Black Hole is up

name: Tidehunter

counters.reason: Anchor Smash drains his damage and Ravage stops God's Strength
Ravage plus Kraken Shell control the spin fight
Thick targets plus Ravage punish Call initiations

counterItems.when: Blink Ravage before Lion and Sniper spread out
Shield the team against Lion Finger and Enigma Pulse

skillTips: Blink Ravage the Sniper pocket first, the rest follows
Anchor Smash the Sven the moment God's Strength pops

name: Enigma

counters.reason: Black Hole holds God's Strength down for the full duration
Eidolons pressure and Midnight Pulse melts his huge health pool

counterItems.when: Blink Black Hole before Lion and Sniper react
Channel through Lion Hex and Sniper headshot flinch

skillTips: Black Hole the Sven, not the Tidehunter: Shell wastes half of it
Show on lane to bait, then Blink Hole the counter-gank
